from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup standard layout
        title = "The 'Translator' Matrix (Change of Basis Matrix)"
        lines = [
            'The Change of Basis Matrix P is our translator.',
            "First column: Penguin's first basis vector in standard terms.",
            "Second column: Penguin's second basis vector in standard terms.",
            'Matrix P columns are the new basis vectors.',
            "This matrix maps the Penguin's world to ours."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Colors
        ORANGE_P = "#FFA500"
        VECTOR_B1_COLOR = BLUE_B
        VECTOR_B2_COLOR = GREEN_B

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Define the coordinates for b1 and b2
        b1_coords = MathTex(r"b_1 = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}", color=VECTOR_B1_COLOR)
        b2_coords = MathTex(r"b_2 = \begin{bmatrix} -1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}", color=VECTOR_B2_COLOR)
        
        self.place_at_grid(b1_coords, "B2", scale_factor=0.9)
        self.place_at_grid(b2_coords, "B5", scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(Write(b1_coords), Write(b2_coords))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)

        # Matrix P setup (empty slots)
        # Using a dummy matrix to get brackets, then placing numbers
        matrix_p_base = MathTex(r"P = \begin{bmatrix} \quad & \quad \\ \quad & \quad \end{bmatrix}", color=ORANGE_P)
        self.place_in_area(matrix_p_base, "C2", "E5", scale_factor=1.5)
        
        # Prepare components of b1 to move
        b1_val_1 = MathTex("1", color=VECTOR_B1_COLOR)
        b1_val_2 = MathTex("1", color=VECTOR_B1_COLOR)
        
        # Initial positions (over b1_coords vector)
        b1_val_1.move_to(b1_coords[0][3]) # Indexing standard Manim MathTex for [1 \\ 1]
        b1_val_2.move_to(b1_coords[0][4])
        
        # Target positions in Matrix P (col 1)
        target_p_11 = matrix_p_base.get_center() + LEFT * 0.4 + UP * 0.4
        target_p_21 = matrix_p_base.get_center() + LEFT * 0.4 + DOWN * 0.4

        self.play(Create(matrix_p_base))
        self.play(
            b1_val_1.animate.move_to(target_p_11).scale(1.5),
            b1_val_2.animate.move_to(target_p_21).scale(1.5),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)

        # Prepare components of b2 to move
        b2_val_1 = MathTex("-1", color=VECTOR_B2_COLOR)
        b2_val_2 = MathTex("1", color=VECTOR_B2_COLOR)
        
        # Initial positions
        b2_val_1.move_to(b2_coords[0][3:5])
        b2_val_2.move_to(b2_coords[0][5])
        
        # Target positions in Matrix P (col 2)
        target_p_12 = matrix_p_base.get_center() + RIGHT * 0.5 + UP * 0.4
        target_p_22 = matrix_p_base.get_center() + RIGHT * 0.5 + DOWN * 0.4

        self.play(
            b2_val_1.animate.move_to(target_p_12).scale(1.5),
            b2_val_2.animate.move_to(target_p_22).scale(1.5),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW)

        # Surround the columns to highlight they are the basis vectors
